_comment: Contestants seeded into the arena database on first run. 'local' models are GGUF files the arena starts llama-server for; 'openai' models are any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. See README.md for the full schema.

models._comment: Cloud contestant, keyed from the environment. Shows up greyed out until $GROQ_API_KEY is set, and is skipped by battles while it is not ready. $GROQ_MODEL picks the model id; override base_url to point at any OpenAI-compatible host.
models.name: groq-llama
